knowledge_gaps: The perturbations are underspecified: user and candidate counts, matching tolerances, timestamp handling, shuffle sampling, tie-breaking, bootstrap settings, and runtime limits are missing.

Deleting events changes both sequence content and positional indices. The report needs controls separating these effects, plus a precise availability-constrained shuffle algorithm and reporting of unchanged or infeasible shuffles.

The adapter measures sensitivity but provides no explicit rule connecting findings to model changes or validation improvements. Its future-potential rating of 8 is speculative, and implementation difficulty may be understated.
Repeated validation-based search can overfit the fixed 800-user validation sample. Diagnostic sampling and execution also need explicit bounds within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

follow_up_queries.reason: Establish a reproducible shuffle procedure and determine whether availability constraints leave enough valid permutations to measure order sensitivity.
follow_up_queries.query: How does 'Disentangling User and Item Sequence Patterns' (RecSys 2025) implement availability-constrained history shuffling? Examine permutation sampling, timestamp ties, first-observed item availability, unchanged histories, and feasible-permutation coverage when adapting the method to left-padded SASRec sequences using training interactions only.

follow_up_queries.reason: Separate event-content effects from positional changes and replace vague matching instructions with implementable controls.
follow_up_queries.query: What controlled history-perturbation methods for SASRec distinguish recent-item dependence from positional-embedding and sequence-length effects? Compare deletion with compaction, position-preserving masking, recent-event removal matched to older events by training popularity and title similarity, and fixed-candidate ranking comparisons; identify matching tolerances, missing-match handling, and rank-displacement definitions.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether the diagnostic extension can guide useful model changes without excessive computation or adaptation to the fixed validation sample.
follow_up_queries.query: What evidence shows that sequential-recommender history-perturbation diagnostics predict useful architecture or training ablations? Investigate prespecified diagnostic-to-ablation rules, paired validation comparisons, and repeated-selection bias for SASRec under a fixed four-dataset macro HR@10 benchmark with 200 validation users per dataset, 99 negatives per user, and a shared 12 GPU-hour search budget.
